title: LIBRAIN: A Multi-Agent RAG System for Scientific Discovery
description: LIBRAIN is a multi-agent retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system for scientific discovery, built on .NET 10. It coordinates Reader, Synthesis, Evaluator, and Discovery agents under a cross-cutting, correlation-ID audit layer. A Discovery Mode fences speculative content into a structured novelClaim field, and a citation-validation contract guarantees that every cited chunk resolves to a real retrieved document, giving zero fabricated references by construction. Generated hypotheses are scored on a four-axis rubric (novelty, plausibility, coherence, quality). The repository contains the full implementation, the evaluation harness, and reproducibility material.
